prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training - maximize carbohydrate intake for endurance and sustained energy during a 20-mile training run

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals 3000+ calories with carbohydrates comprising 60-65% of total calories
Includes 4-5 meals/snacks distributed throughout the day to maintain sustained energy
Contains easily digestible, high-carb foods suitable for endurance athletes (e.g., oats, pasta, bananas, rice)
Meal plan is presented in compact, concise format suitable for quick reference
task_description: write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athelete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathoner) requiring 3000+ calories with emphasis on carbohydrate loading and sustained energy

prompt_inputs.goal: Muscle recovery and strength gains post-training

solution_criteria: Meal plan is formatted as a single day with clear meal times (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks)
Protein comprises approximately 30-35% of total daily calories with emphasis on high-quality sources
Includes specific food items and approximate portions that are realistic for a weightlifter
task_description: write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athelete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) requiring protein-focused nutrition with specific macronutrient ratios for muscle recovery

prompt_inputs.goal: Optimize performance and recovery for match day with sustained energy and quick carbohydrate availability

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all three meals plus pre/during match nutrition timing
Includes adequate carbohydrates (6-10g per kg body weight) for aerobic capacity and match intensity
Incorporates lean protein sources for muscle recovery
Specifies timing and portions appropriate for a professional soccer match day
